hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("\\bgit\\b[^|;&]*\\b(commit|push)\\b|\\bgh\\b[^|;&]*\\bpr\\b[^|;&]*\\bcreate\\b")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"CLAUDE.md: commit/push/PR creation requires an explicit user request — confirm before running."}} else empty end'

jq -e '(.tool_input.command // "") | test("\\bgit\\b[^|;&]*\\bcommit\\b")' >/dev/null && [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CLAUDE.md: never commit on main — create a working branch from the latest remote main first."}}' || true

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("README(\\.ja)?\\.md$|/docs/[^/]+\\.md$")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"Bilingual-pair rule (CONTRIBUTING.md): this file has an English/Japanese counterpart (X.md / X.ja.md). Update the counterpart in the same PR (English first)."}} else empty end'
